doc.name: 402lounge
doc.instructions: 402lounge: receipts and a register for AI agents that pay with x402 (USDC on Base). Every account is a company: lounge.signup creates it with you as its agent and your wallet; company.update adds the legal data the monthly vouchers need; company.invite and company.join bring more agents in. After every x402 payment call receipts.record with the transaction hash and the URL you paid; a receipt with the seller, the description, the paying agent and a EUR value follows. register.lookup tells you who is behind a payTo address before you pay. The company gets one document per seller every month (invoices.list), the month so far is in invoices.draft. Free tools work without an account. People connect over OAuth: the first tool that needs the account opens the sign-in on app.402lounge.com, and the app then acts with their role in the company. Call lounge.requirements first if you are new.

tools.name: company.update
tools.title: Fill in or change the company data
tools.description: Admins only. Your account starts as a company named after you. A company is ready for invoices (tier invoice_ready) once it has name, legal_form (or sole_proprietor), owner_name for a sole proprietor, address_line1, postal_code, city, country, a confirmed email and its VAT status with the number: in the EU a VAT id VIES confirms (checked at once), or the tax_number for small businesses and VAT-exempt companies. Until then it gets receipts and a preview of its monthly documents, and buying a plan waits. Any subset works, and the answer lists what is still missing (missing_for_company).

name.description: Legal name of the company, without the legal form

address_line1.description: Street and number of the registered address

address_line2.description: Optional second line of the address

postal_code.description: Postal code of the registered address

address_state.description: State or province, written after the city in the USA, Canada and Australia (TX, ON, NSW)

sole_proprietor.description: True for one person without a legal form of its own where the country has none to choose. Then owner_name is required

language.description: Language of documents and mails: en, de, fr, it, es, nl, pt, sv, da, fi or nb. Null takes the language of the country

vat_id.description: VAT id in the format of its country, like DE123456789 or ATU12345678 (GET /v1/countries). EU numbers are checked against VIES

tax_number.description: The national tax number, for vat_status tax_number or where the country asks for it

vat_status.description: How the company stands with VAT: vat_id, tax_number (registered, VAT id still to come), small_business (§ 19 UStG) exempt (only VAT-exempt sales) or not_registered (no VAT registration, the USA or another country without VAT). Decides the tax note on its documents

own_accounts.description: With skr OWN: the expense, clearing and USDC holding accounts of your chart, 4 to 8 digits, and optionally gift_cards for gift card purchases (the expense account otherwise)

tools.name: billing.quote
tools.title: Pay 402lounge in USDC
tools.description: Admin agents, the owner and finance. An offer to pay in USDC on Base: a plan (plan + period), the archive for a company without a paid plan (archive: month or year) or the seller check for level 2 (seller_check: your listing slug, one year). The price is net in EUR, with VAT for your company and the ECB rate of the day, and the amount in USDC is unique for 30 minutes. Pay it yourself with your x402 client on pay_url, or a person sends exactly amount_usdc to pay_to. 402lounge sends an invoice. Nothing renews by itself. With quote_id only: the status of that offer, with the invoice once paid.

tools.name: seller.check
tools.title: The company check of a listing (level 2)
tools.description: Level 2 for a listing of your company on level 1: action start {listing} opens the check and returns its steps. The domain of the listing is proved by an email address at it: email {id, email} sends a code there, confirm_email {id, code} confirms it. Without a mailbox, add the DNS TXT record from the check instead (_402lounge.<host>, value 402lounge-verify=<token>). verify {id} runs the steps again (company data with the name of the person who acts for the company, VIES, the domain, EU sanctions list, payment). Once all pass, 402lounge approves it, then the listing is on level 2 for a year. checkout {id} gives the Polar link for 10 € a year, included in Books. get {id}, withdraw {id}.

action.description: start, get, verify, email, confirm_email, checkout or withdraw, as the description explains

id.description: The check, from start. Every action but start needs it

email.description: email: an address at the domain of the listing

code.description: confirm_email: the six-digit code from the mail
